test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a roundworm?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ascaris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ascaris,** also known as a **nematode or roundworm,** is a **parasitic organism.**
 
• Specifically, **Ascaris lumbricoides** is a type of **parasitic roundworm** responsible for causing ascariasis, an infection transmitted when individuals consume food or water contaminated with roundworm eggs.
 
• **Ascariasis **is the most prevalent intestinal worm infection globally, but it is relatively rare in the United States.
 
• It primarily affects children in tropical and subtropical regions, particularly in areas with inadequate sanitation and hygiene practices.
 
• **Adult female Ascaris worms** can reach lengths exceeding one foot, while adult males typically measure between 15 to 30 centimeters.
 
• These worms inhabit the small intestine of their hosts, which include pigs and humans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Planaria **are a genus of flatworms that are free-living and have the remarkable ability to regenerate missing body parts.
 
• **Liver fluke** refers to a group of parasitic flatworms, known as trematodes, which infect the livers of various mammals, including humans.
 
• **Taenia** is a genus of tapeworms that encompasses more than 100 species, responsible for causing cysticercosis and taeniasis in humans.
